reviews.review_title: Shein isn't what it used to be
reviews.review_text:
Shein isn't what it used to be, frustrating experience. 

​I’ve been a loyal customer for a long time, but Shein is honestly not what it used to be. Lately, the service has gone downhill completely.
​Inaccurate Stock: I keep finding that products are listed incorrectly regarding their actual availability.
​Shipping & Lost Packages: Delivery times are now painfully long, and to make matters worse, packages frequently get lost in transit.
​Terrible Customer Support: Trying to get help is a nightmare. There is virtually no real customer support anymore.
​No Refunds: If your package goes missing, it is now incredibly difficult to actually get a refund. They make you jump through endless hoops.
​While I still find many items that interest me, the constant headaches mean I will think twice before ordering from them again. Proceed with caution.

reviews.review_title: Very poor experience with SHEIN’s…
reviews.review_text:
Very poor experience with SHEIN’s refund process.

I placed an order in December 2025, but the package never arrived. After reporting the issue, I had to go through a refund process that took almost a month, with several emails, incomplete responses, and repeated requests for information.

From the beginning, I asked for the refund to be issued as SHEIN Wallet credit, because I had already experienced problems with bank refunds before. Later, their support team asked me for an alternative account to process the refund, so I provided my PayPal account.

However, only a small portion of the refund, around USD 15, was sent to PayPal. The rest was sent in several split amounts to my bank account, which was exactly the method I had asked them to avoid.

The biggest issue is that I originally paid for the order in one single transaction, not in separate payments. Therefore, if SHEIN decided to refund the original card, they should have refunded the exact amount corresponding to the original card transaction, not several fragmented amounts. Because of this, my bank is not properly recognizing or releasing part of the refund, since the amounts do not match the original purchase transaction.

This makes the situation even more frustrating. Why ask me where I wanted the refund to be sent if, in the end, they were going to process it however they wanted, without following the refund method I provided?

As a result, after almost a month of emails, claims, and additional paperwork with my bank, I still cannot access a significant part of my money.

This has been a very frustrating and poorly managed refund process. SHEIN should have respected the refund method I requested, or at least processed the refund correctly according to the original transaction.

Unfortunately, based on this experience, I cannot recommend SHEIN’s customer service or refund process.

The report number is: 57232576.

It is unacceptable to treat customers this way when a time-sensitive order is delayed for this long. I will not be shopping with this company again.

reviews.review_title: Lost parcel, endless excuses and terrible customer service
reviews.review_text:
After wasting countless hours contacting both SHEIN and BoxNow, BoxNow finally confirmed that the parcel had already been returned to SHEIN. Only then did SHEIN acknowledge the issue.

What is most disappointing is that I had warned them from the beginning that something was wrong, but they repeatedly dismissed my concerns and kept blaming the carrier instead of investigating.

These items were meant for my son's birthday, and because of their lack of action I was left without them on time. This caused unnecessary stress and frustration that could have been avoided if they had simply listened to their customer.

A company should not be judged by how it performs when everything goes smoothly, but by how it handles problems. In my case, SHEIN failed completely. Instead of taking responsibility, they wasted my time with generic replies and passed the blame to someone else.

I have completely lost confidence in SHEIN's customer service and will seriously reconsider placing any future orders.

Update: SHEIN replied with a generic message stating that a solution had been sent by email. However, this does not address the real issue: my concerns were repeatedly dismissed until BoxNow confirmed that the parcel had already been returned to SHEIN. The refund was never the main issue—the way my case was handled was.
